Me and Bev: 5 to 12 June, with the handover on 5 June.
Jan: 7 to 14 August.
Carol: Easter week and a week in September.

There are no clashes this year. Carol, let me know which week in September you would like.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned again about it.

Also, just so nobody is surprised, the park says caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 years old now, so we will need to get that sorted.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
